verdict.rationale: Terraform's docs explicitly describe the `terraform state` command for 'basic modifications of the state using the CLI' (state mv/rm/list are part of this family) plus import for adding resources to state, directly supporting safe state refactoring [terraform-docs-6, terraform-docs-5, terraform-docs-19, terraform-docs-20]. Community commentary acknowledges the real-world stakes of state manipulation ('when you mess up your state occasionally, yea that's super annoying') reinforcing that this is a recognized, high-stakes capability [terraform-comm-8]. Missing for 10: explicit mention/testing of `terraform state mv` and `terraform state rm` subcommands by name, and no hands-on probe exercising a full move/rename/remove workflow (probes only cover plan/apply/destroy, not state surgery).
